summary: Implemented grid-sampled patch iteration. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs with [start, stop] per dimension in the unpadded frame; set_rnd skips __-prefixed attributes; docstrings updated), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset rewritten to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; NotImplementedError on missing len; math import replaced by numpy ceil; PatchDataset docstring uses float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array using the pinned spec values). Nothing was run: tests, the docstring example, and the pinned values are unverified and need a pytest run on tests/test_grid_dataset.py. Two pre-existing lines over 120 characters remain in utils.py get_valid_patch_size docstring. No commit was made.
